holdings.name: TD Power Systems Ltd

what_changed.text: TD Power Systems raised Rs 600 crore through a qualified institutional placement, allotting 77,41,935 equity shares at Rs 775 per share on October 12, 2026.
For the quarter ended June 2026, sales increased to Rs 640 crore with a net profit of Rs 86 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: TD Power Systems represents 1.88% of the fund and generated a 30.38% return over 3 months, contributing 0.571% to portfolio performance.

watch.text: Watch the deployment of the Rs 600 crore QIP proceeds toward business expansion.

holdings.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd

what_changed.text: In Q2 FY27, BHEL reported a 24% increase in revenue, a 120% jump in PAT, and an order book standing at Rs 2.58 lakh crore.
The board approved Rs 500 crore for additional facilities at HEEP-Haridwar.

holdings.why_it_matters: BHEL is the second largest holding at 1.77% and solidifies the fund's 24.1% concentration in Industrials.

watch.text: Track execution against the Rs 2.58 lakh crore order book and the Haridwar facility expansion.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for Q2 FY27 reached Rs 21,537 crore, while Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha is scheduled to step down on December 31, 2026.
Treasury income fell 67% and margins reached record lows in the September 2026 quarter.

expected.text: Analyst consensus tracked Q2 net profit expectations, with reported profit broadly meeting or falling slightly below select estimates.

seeing.text: Actual net profit grew between 4.7% and 5% year-on-year to Rs 19,510 crore on a standalone basis.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.75% weight, HDFC Bank's -11.07% 3-month return shaved 0.194% from the portfolio, making it the top detractor.

watch.text: Monitor leadership transition as Deputy MD Bharucha steps down in December 2026.
Watch for margin stabilization after record lows reported in Q2.

holdings.name: Apar Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: First quarter sales reached Rs 6,591 crore and net profit rose to Rs 467 crore.
The company set a board meeting for October 29, 2026 to review second-quarter and half-year financial results.

holdings.why_it_matters: Apar Industries holds a 1.74% weight and contributed 0.276% over the last 3 months with a 15.88% return.

watch.text: Review second-quarter earnings performance at the board meeting on October 29, 2026.

holdings.name: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd.

what_changed.text: A subsidiary signed a 25-year power purchase agreement with SECI for 300 MW of peak power at Rs 6.00 per unit under FDRE Tranche IX.
The firm incorporated UAE subsidiary ACME Renewables FZCO and domestic units Amshuman Renewables and Urjita Powertech.
ICRA reaffirmed the company's rating at AA- Stable and increased total rated facilities to Rs 3,500 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.33% weight, ACME Solar is the fund's primary renewable play within its 4.0% Energy & Utilities allocation.

watch.text: Follow commercial implementation of the 300 MW SECI agreement and operational ramp-up in newly established subsidiaries.

holdings.name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Karur Vysya Bank reported a 37% year-on-year increase in Q2 net profit.
Ramshankar R assumed the role of COO on October 16, 2026, following the exit of Chandrasekaran M S.

expected.text: Management targeted 18% to 20% credit growth for FY27, with corporate lending capped at 20%.

seeing.text: The bank signaled caution on gold loan exposures while prioritizing net interest margins.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.28% portfolio weight, the bank contributed 0.189% over 3 months, counterbalancing losses from large banking peers.

watch.text: Track loan growth against the 18% to 20% FY27 target while watching the COO leadership transition.

holdings.name: Sai Life Sciences Ltd.

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarter sales were Rs 554 crore with net profit of Rs 73 crore.
The board scheduled a meeting for November 5, 2026 to approve Q2 FY27 results.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 1.24% of the fund, Sai Life Sciences provides exposure to the 9.1% Healthcare allocation.

watch.text: Monitor financial numbers and margin trends at the November 5, 2026 board meeting.

holdings.name: Sundram Fasteners Ltd

what_changed.text: CRISIL reaffirmed Sundram Fasteners' short-term debt and commercial paper rating at A1+ on September 21, 2026.
Stock exchanges approved the reclassification of three promoter group entities to the public category.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 1.20%, the stock delivered a 15.08% 3-month return, adding 0.181% to fund performance.

watch.text: Watch commercial paper issuances and financing costs following the CRISIL A1+ rating reaffirmation.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: SBI increased lending rates across EBLR and RLL benchmarks, raising loan EMIs.
SBI acquired almost 40% of Reliance's $1.35 billion debt sale on September 30, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.19% weight, SBI's -7.82% 3-month decline weighed on the fund's 16.0% Financials sector performance.

watch.text: Track retail credit demand and margin effects following the revision in lending rates.

holdings.name: Elantas Beck India Ltd

what_changed.text: Elantas Beck India expanded its presence into battery storage chemicals.
The board scheduled a meeting for October 28, 2026 to approve Q2 and nine-month results.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.16% weight, it was the fund's highest 3-month contributor (+0.594%) with a 51.25% return in the Materials sector.

watch.text: Assess Q2 financial results and commercial milestones in battery storage chemicals on October 28, 2026.

portfolio.statement: Nippon India Small Cap Fund manages Rs 80,906 crore with 97.4% equity exposure, led by Industrials at 24.1% and Financials at 16.0%, keeping single-stock exposure under 2% per company.
interp: The portfolio maintains low individual stock concentration, with the top 10 holdings accounting for only 14.5% of assets.
Strong gains across power equipment, engineering, and specialty materials countered weakness in large-cap banking names.
portfolio.line: Capital goods and electrical equipment drove gains, while large bank margin pressures limited overall 3-month returns.

drivers.text: Elantas Beck India and TD Power Systems delivered strong quarterly returns, adding 0.594% and 0.571% respectively to performance.
HDFC Bank fell 11.07% over 3 months as margins reached record lows and treasury income dropped 67%, detracting 0.194%.

themes.title: Power Infrastructure and Electrification
themes.text: Substantial order books and fresh institutional capital raises support power-equipment manufacturers and renewable power producers.

themes.title: Diverging Banking Dynamics
themes.text: Regional banks demonstrated strong profit growth while larger national lenders experienced rate adjustments and margin compression.

macro.why: Higher grid and renewable capacity investments are boosting backlogs and revenues for equipment suppliers.
Lenders are resetting benchmark lending rates while balancing credit growth targets against margin contraction.

priced_in.text: BHEL's revenue growth of 24% and its order backlog of Rs 2.58 lakh crore are reflected in its 84.02% 1-year share price gain.
TD Power Systems' Rs 600 crore QIP at Rs 775 per share closed after a 130.71% 1-year stock rally.

could_change.title: Banking Net Interest Margins
could_change.text: If lending rate revisions stabilize margins at HDFC Bank and SBI while Karur Vysya hits its 18-20% growth target, Financials could shift from a drag to a contributor.

could_change.title: Execution of Capital Goods Order Books
could_change.text: Sustained momentum in Industrials depends on timely delivery across BHEL's Rs 2.58 lakh crore backlog and deployment of TD Power's newly raised equity.

portfolio.risk_note: With a beta of 0.90, maximum drawdown of -24.21%, and a 24.1% concentration in Industrials, the portfolio is sensitive to domestic manufacturing and power capex execution.
